title: Historical net-loss evidence: both reported periods remain loss-making
finding: The retained filing reports net losses of $110,845 for May–July 2025 and $218,662 for May–July 2024. The signed reported amount differs by $107,817, a narrower reported loss, not a profit or an earnings-growth percentage.
